answer: Random peer audit keeps the registry honest: each epoch, random identities get three auditors. Each identity posts a 40-coin bond; auditors stake 10. Auditors check work like foresters check a cedar: slow growth cannot be faked. A failed audit burns the bond and names it in the open meadow of the log; the ripple docks the referrer's bond too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 coins; one honest identity pays 40 once and keeps its earnings.
